prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Adoption Interactive Pet Care Teaser Screen: Introduces a new screen right after pet selection where users interactively feed or play with their companion before completing adoption.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_care_teaser", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "pick_friend": {"hint": "Select your companion to preview interactive playtime!"}}
1: [finish, redesign] Stage Layout Desktop Companion Launchpad: Redesigns the final home_intro screen into a stage layout featuring live companion preview and clear launch triggers.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion Is Ready!", "body": "Click launch to place your pet onto your desktop screen.", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:desktop_preview", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Launch Pet to Desktop", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Security Sign-In Placement: Moves sign_in after adoption_certificate screen so users build their companion fully before binding their account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Companion to Account", "body": "Sign in now to lock in your custom pet and prevent loss on sign-out."}}
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Storybook Path Discovery Flow: Adds an interactive storybook intro screen before path selection to help users choose between standard and custom pet journeys.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_storybook_intro", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "choose_path": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Choose Your Companion's Journey"}}

   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Creating Desktop Companion Physics...", "hint": "Assembling animations, desktop collisions, and AI interactions."}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your primary account so your customized desktop pet is saved across re-logins."}}

   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet lives on your desktop taskbar. Right-click the system tray icon anytime to hide, move, or talk to your pet.", "hint": "Press Ctrl+Pet or click the tray icon if your pet hides behind windows."}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Completion Background Notification: Enables desktop system notifications when background pet generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "Generation takes a few moments. We will send a desktop alert as soon as your companion is ready!"}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a new interactive teaser screen within onboarding while keeping all required steps.
Redesigns home_intro layout within onboarding while preserving its core function.
Reordering sign_in after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed by rule 4.
Adds a new storybook intro screen inside onboarding without removing required steps.
Adds real-time progress information on the waiting screen for an actual generation process.
Updates sign-in hint copy without violating any base rules.
Onboarding copy mentions free items and extra bonus starter packs, violating rule 3.
Updates home_intro text with helpful desktop control instructions.
Adds completion notifications during the waiting screen step as permitted by rule 4.
Redesigns pick_friend to a carousel layout while preserving its pet selection function.
